X-Request-ID.name: X-Request-ID
X-Request-ID.description: ID of the request, unique to the call, as determined by the initiating party.

PSU-ID.name: PSU-ID
PSU-ID.description: Client ID used by the PSU in the sphere of the ASPSP.

Digest.name: Digest
Digest.description: Is contained if and only if the related message contains a body. HTTP-header Digest of the payload, as defined in RFC 3230.

Signature.name: Signature
Signature.description: A signature of the request by the TPP on relevant fields, in appropriate cases. Relevant fields are the HTTP-header fields (e.g. Digest, X-Request-ID, PSU-ID, etc.).

PSU-IP-Address.name: PSU-IP-Address
PSU-IP-Address.description: The IP address of the PSU (Client).

TPP-Signature-Certificate.name: TPP-Signature-Certificate
TPP-Signature-Certificate.description: The certificate used for the signature by the TPP, in appropriate cases.

Idempotency-Key.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency-Key.description: Every Idempotency-Key expires after 24 hours. If a new request is submitted with the same Idempotency-Key, the system will return the same response as the original request, preventing duplicate processing.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: The number of records to return.

errorCode.description: Unique error code (e.g., CONSENT_EXPIRED). Identifies the specific business or technical error.

message.description: Technical description of the error in English for developers.
examples: The consent provided for this operation has expired.

userMessage.description: Human-readable description of the error in Hebrew for the end user.
examples: תוקף ההרשאה פג. יש לחדש את הסכמת הלקוח.

path.description: The API path where the error occurred.

timestamp.description: Precise timestamp of the error occurrence.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the original request, matches X-Request-ID.

type.description: A URI reference [RFC3986] that identifies the problem type.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: The HTTP status code [RFC7231, Section 6] generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

href.description: Direct link to a resource. Example: http://example.com/api/v1/resource

templated.description: If true, the href is a URI template (RFC 6570)

_links.description: HAL-style links for document operations. Example: http://example.com/api/v1/documents/upload
HAL-style links for document operations. Example: http://example.com/api/v1/documents/{id}/download
